name: toolbox
description: Cool little tools for Claude Code, by jamubc.

plugins.name: redline
plugins.description: A tachometer for your Claude sessions: when the needle hits the redline, stop spawning and start finishing.

plugins.name: channel
plugins.description: Your chats in a pane beside Claude Code: read, reply, see pictures inline, page back through history, and get a toast when someone messages you. iMessage today, more chat apps to come.

plugins.name: instantnotes
plugins.description: Your InstantNotes in a pane beside Claude Code: search as you type, read a note as Markdown, write one in the pane or with /note.

plugins.name: browse
plugins.description: Adds /browse: a web browser in a pane beside Claude Code.

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: Adds /atlas: a file explorer in a pane beside Claude Code, with git marks, search by name or text, and micro to edit a file.

plugins.name: orbit
plugins.description: A globe of everything your Claude session talks to: tool calls, sockets and bytes traced to hosts, countries and orgs, with a deny-list that blocks before a call runs.
